title: Improving Medical PrActice using Photon-Counting Computed Tomography at a Tertiary Referral Center
summary: Photon counting CT showed great potential in reducing radiation dose while improving image quality. These effects will be examined during the routine use of the new technology in a specialized hospital. Specific interventions are not part of this purely observational study.
conditions: Patients with an indication for CT imaging

interventions.name: Historisches Kollektiv aus dem Zeitraum 07/2020-07/2025, das vor der Inbetriebnahme des Photon-Counting CT (PCCT) an einem Energie-integrierenden Detektor (EID) untersucht wurde.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. any patient who receives a PCCT between 08/2025 - 08/2030 during routine care and consents to participation in this study (prospective cohort Erhebung) 
2.	patients who were examined between 08/2020 and 08/2025 during clinical routine using the previous CT technology (retrospective cohort)
Exclusion criteria:
Refusal to participate in the study
